description: Extension of CanvasWindowController implementing WKNavigationDelegate methods to handle URL navigation policies within a WKWebView in a macOS application.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A controller managing the web view in a macOS app, extended here to handle navigation decisions.

methods.name: webView(decidePolicyFor:navigationAction:decisionHandler:)
